title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: Fixes a gap where @Suppress("unused") on an anonymous companion object was ignored and its members got deleted anyway.

highlights.title: Companion Object Suppress Fix
highlights.description: A @Suppress("unused") annotation written on an anonymous companion object is now respected, so Remove Everything Unused no longer deletes its members.

highlights.title: Release Notes Script Refined
highlights.description: The internal script that drafts these release notes gained more test coverage, aimed at keeping future notes accurate.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Stops deleting members of an anonymous companion object marked @Suppress("unused"): the 1.42.325 fix checked the member and its enclosing declarations for the suppress request, but an anonymous companion object is never emitted as a symbol, so it was never part of that chain and its members were still removed by Remove Everything Unused. A named companion object was already covered, which is why the gap went unnoticed.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: Ships no other changes to extension behavior: every command and setting works exactly as it did in 1.42.325.

Release notes no longer show a stray backslash in front of quotes. The 1.42.325 summary displayed one around "unused"; the drafting step now removes them and the release check refuses any that remain.
